variants.headline: Builder signs for a new project
variants.body: The builder {builder} has signed a contract for {project}. The gazette records the development as a matter deserving careful attention in the public interest.

variants.headline: A price agreed, a building still to deliver
variants.body: A construction contract for {project} has been awarded to {builder}. The gazette records the development as a matter deserving careful attention in the public interest.

variants.headline: Construction contract puts obligations in writing
variants.body: The company {builder} has won the building contract for {project}. The gazette records the development as a matter deserving careful attention in the public interest.
